text:
maria: Proposal: introduce a concise "fence" object + short-lived handshake lease to make enforcement explicit across hosted/dedicated/private.
kai: tl;dr?
maria: fence = immutable policy snapshot (allowed_actions, kv_cache_policy, kms_whitelist, egress_constraints). Control plane mints lease tokens bound to fence id + node fingerprint. Runtime caches fence by lease_id; requests carry lease_id only.
leah: example fence sketch?
maria: fence:
  id: fence-2026-4132
  hosting: dedicated
  allowed_actions: [inference]
  kv_cache: disabled
  kms_whitelist: [cust-kms]
  fallback_policy: degrade
david: perf worry: handshake per req?
maria: no, handshake per lease. runtime maintains shared-mem lookup keyed by lease_id. rotation triggers new handshake.
josh: overflow behavior? hosted->dedicated?
maria: fence.fallback_policy decides: fail_closed, degrade_to, or proxy_via gateway. explicit mapping makes behavior auditable.
leah: migration path?
maria: compatibility shim synthesizes fences from existing manifests at handshake time and marks them synthesized. Ops console shows fence lineage.
ops-bot: note: include audit fields and mark synthesized fences.
kai: I can prototype runtime plugin (fast lease cache + validators).
leah: I'll draft RFC + migration checklist.
josh: I'll draft token spec and threat model.
maria: I'll mock Console UX and templates.
ops-bot: tag RFC hosting-abstraction and set review in 2 weeks.
